Subject: Integration roadmap proposal & stakeholder confirmation — BrightPath

Hi Emma / Rahul —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our discovery, I put together a short integration roadmap and an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft attached. The goal here is to align on milestones, owners, and a target close window so we can scope the Dedicated deployment and SOC/compliance checks.

High-level milestones (proposal):
- Week 0–2: Technical deep-dive + network/firewall checklist (BrightPath devs + Redwood infra)
- Week 3–4: Private deployment staging & validation (SOC 2 evidence review)
- Week 5–6: Pilot load testing & performance tuning
- Week 7: Production rollout and sign-off

I've left two timeline options in the attached spreadsheet (aggressive vs. conservative) — please pick which aligns to your procurement and security timelines.

Ask: can you confirm the primary internal stakeholders for procurement, security, and the SRE/infra owner we should loop in? I noted Rahul for the technical owner and asked procurement@brightpath.com to be included for contract timing.

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf (MAP draft), proposed-timeline.xlsx (timeline options)

If you're good with this structure, I'll convert the attached PDF into a living MAP in Drive and circulate a link for collaborative edits.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the recap and the MAP draft. Quick notes from our side after reviewing with Rahul: 

- Timeline: procurement will need at least 3 weeks for review + legal redlines. The conservative timeline aligns better (we'd prefer target close in ~8–10 weeks vs. 6).
- Security: we absolutely need SOC 2 Type II evidence and network segmentation docs before staging. Can Redwood share SOC reports and an overview of data residency controls?
- Stakeholders: please include Priya N. (procurement@brightpath.com), Selena M. (security@brightpath.com) and our SRE lead, Dan Moore (dan.moore@brightpath.com). Rahul remains the technical lead for the POC.
